title: Human Resources Benefits Coordinator
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR Benefits Lead to own and enhance our employee benefits function while helping build the infrastructure for a scalable, high-performing benefits team. This individual will serve as the subject matter expert for all aspects of benefits administration, ensuring compliance, improving employee experience, and partnering closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors.


This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex programs, improving existing processes, and creating a best-in-class benefits function.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end administration of employee benefits programs across a multi-state workforce spanning more than 30 states.
  • Manage all health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefits.
  • Own the administration of the company's 401(k) plan, ensuring timely and accurate retirement plan administration, non-discrimination testing, audits, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner closely with payroll to ensure accurate deductions, benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, and reconciliation of benefit data.
  • Oversee leave administration, including FMLA, ADA accommodations, short-term disability, long-term disability, and applicable state leave program
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations governing employee benefits across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance brokers, retirement plan advisors, and third-party administrators to negotiate plan design, control costs, and improve service levels.
  • Analyze benefit utilization, market trends, and employee feedback to recommend enhancements to benefit offerings.
  • Translate complex benefit plans into clear, employee-friendly communications that help employees make informed enrollment decisions.
  • Develop scalable processes, documentation, and internal controls to support future team growth.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefit questions and escalated issues.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive HR benefits experience with ownership of end-to-end benefits administration.
  • Experience supporting a multi-state employee population across 30 or more states.
  • Deep knowledge of medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefit plans.
  • Strong expertise in 401(k) administration, including retirement plan compliance, non-discrimination testing, annual reporting, and vendor management.
  • Demonstrated experience administering FMLA, ADA, short-term disability, long-term disability, and state leave progra
  • Strong understanding of ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, ACA, and other applicable benefits regulations.
  • Experience partnering closely with payroll to ensure accurate benefit processing and compliance.
  • Proven ability to establish and manage strategic relationships with insurance brokers and benefit providers while evaluating plan design and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex benefits information for employees and leadership.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.


Preferred Background

  • Experience stepping into an environment where benefits programs required stabilization and operational improvement.
  • Takes ownership of critical programs, particularly the company's 401(k), ensuring every aspect of retirement administration is accurate and compliant rather than simply processing transactions.
  • Comfortable bringing structure to under-managed programs and implementing sustainable processes.
  • Proven ability to influence brokers and insurance carriers on pricing, plan design, and service expectations.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal benefits function and mentoring future team members.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise Sales - DACH
Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Berlin I Germany, EMEA I Remote
description:
How will you make an impact?

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.

What you will be working on:

  • Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.

  • AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.

  • Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.

Some of your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.

  • Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together.

Expectations timeline

1 Month

You'll complete onboarding covering our product, tech stack, infrastructure, and vision. You'll meet people across the company, get familiar with our codebase, and ship your first contributions. You'll start building context on how our customers use Hygraph and what matters most to them.

3 Months

You'll be delivering features and improvements to production with confidence. You'll have a solid understanding of Hygraph's product and architecture, and you'll be contributing ideas, not just code. You'll have built working relationships with your team lead, PMs, designers, and fellow engineers through regular 1:1s, operational reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

6 Months

By now, you'll be making significant contributions to both the product and the team. You'll bring fresh perspectives from your experience and help raise the bar across performance, architecture, and how we work. You'll be someone the team relies on. Not because you do everything, but because you make everyone around you better.


What we expect from you:

Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally Node.js).

  • Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React.

  • Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL.

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP).

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar).

  • Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.).

  • Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps.

  • Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Golang.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform).

  • Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles.

  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure.

The Process

  • Intro call with People Team

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Technical Interview

  • C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional)

  • Job Offer

The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks. You could expect some alterations when necessary.

About us

Hygraph is a dynamic Berlin-based startup and a GraphQL-native, API-first headless CMS built for teams delivering complex, composable digital experiences. Hygraph is on a mission to eliminate complexity for global teams and help them scale content without friction. Our platform empowers you to create, deliver, and distribute content faster and at scale. We’re a team committed to shaping the future of AI-powered content platforms. Trusted by over 50,000 teams worldwide, Hygraph powers structured content across websites, applications, product experiences, and AI-enabled systems.

As AI reshapes how digital experiences are created and operated, Hygraph is helping organizations build on structured, trusted content foundations that enable human-first, AI-accelerated experiences at scale. You will be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately. We believe in a remote-first approach where everyone is encouraged to do their best from wherever they are and work together with transparency, accountability, and ownership. We learn continuously through feedback and have a yearly learning budget to attend training and conferences.

Hygraph is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We believe that diversity, unique experiences, qualities, and different cultures enrich our workspace's productivity and promote innovation and creativity.

Note: We are fortunate to receive a large number of applications for our roles. To manage this effectively and give each application the attention it deserves, we use AI-assisted tools to help assess certain screening questions and handle application elements. This helps us ensure a consistent and timely review process. All final hiring decisions are made exclusively by our human recruitment team.

Instagrid ships hardware — globally, at volume, to customers who expect their orders to arrive on time and on spec. As a Working Student in Logistics, you keep that promise. You are the operational backbone of our internal shipping area: handling incoming and outgoing goods, managing documentation, coordinating carriers, and serving as the link between physical goods movement and the Sales and Customer Management teams who need accurate, real-time information to do their jobs.

This is an on-site role in Ludwigsburg. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Operations team — expect to spend real time on the warehouse floor, not behind a screen.

Your Impact

  • A lean, hands-on team that gives direct feedback and expects you to speak up when something isn't right

title: Mitarbeiter Qualitätsmanagement / Qualitätssicherung (gn)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter Qualitätsmanagement / Qualitätssicherung (gn) in Vollzeit.

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig.

Das sind deine Aufgaben bei uns:

  • Du stellst die Einhaltung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Qualitäts- und Lebensmittelsicherheitsstandards sicher.

  • Du planst, koordinierst und begleitest interne sowie externe Audits.

  • Du entwickelst unser Qualitätsmanagementsystem, Prozesse und Dokumentationen weiter.

  • Du arbeitest aktiv in den HACCP-, Food-Defense- und Food-Fraud-Teams mit.

  • Du bearbeitest Reklamationen und Beanstandungen und leitest geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Du planst und führst Schulungen in den Bereichen Qualität, Hygiene und Lebensmittelsicherheit durch.

  • Du unterstützt die Fachbereiche bei qualitätsrelevanten Fragestellungen und der Umsetzung von Qualitätsanforderungen.

Mit diesen Qualifikationen überzeugst du uns:

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmitteltechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

  • Kenntnisse der relevanten Qualitäts- und Lebensmittelsicherheitsstandards, wie IFS-Food, HACCP oder GMP.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- und Hygienebewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft, Ownership für deinen Aufgabenbereich zu übernehmen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Das kannst du von uns erwarten:

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit allen Fachbereichen.

  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem zukunftssicheren Unternehmen der Lebensmittelindustrie.

  • Attraktive Vergütung, Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte und Firmenfitness.

  • Ein motiviertes Team mit offener und wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur.

  • Persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Unternehmen, das sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn Du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich einfach über unseren Bewerbungsbutton und das entsprechende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn Du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst Du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.

Bei Plukon bist Du Teil eines führenden europäischen Foodkonzerns

Bei Plukon beschäftigt zu sein, bedeutet, an der verantwortungsvollen Ernährung von 265 Mio. Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern in Europa mitzuarbeiten. Unser Sortiment reicht von Mahlzeitkomponenten bis hin zu Fertiggerichten und Salaten. So haben wir Angebote für Geflügelfans, genauso wie für Flexitarierinnen und Flexitarier sowie für Vegetarierinnen und Vegetarier. title: Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini which software is best for inspections and audits. Whatever it answers was infuenced off our website, on review sites, in trade media, in the sources AI has learned to trust. Your job is to make that answer Lumiform.

That fight is won off-page, and right now it is wide open. It is also one of Lumiform's biggest growth bets for the year ahead. We want one dedicated, hungry person to own it end to end. That could be you.

About the Role

For us, this is a whole, new channel, and you build it from scratch. You will make Lumiform the name that gets cited, listed and recommended everywhere buyers and AI answer engines look. Some days that is pitching a data backed benchmark report to a trade journalist. Some days it is getting us into a "best inspection software" roundup, running a review campaign on G2/Capterra, or landing us in the right industry association. It is hands-on, high-output work, and you will see the impact fast.

You do not need a long CV. You need to be resourceful, quick to learn, and impatient to see your work move the needle.

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Citations for AI answer engines: Analyze which sources LLMs cite for our must-win topics, then get Lumiform into those listicles, roundups and comparison articles.
  • Review strategy and management: Own our presence on G2, Capterra, the App Store and Play Store, from running review campaigns to replying to reviews in line with our positioning.
  • Digital PR and media outreach: Pitch our benchmark reports, ROI calculators and data stories to trade media, industry publications and journalists, and turn those relationships into coverage and citations. This is our biggest authority bet, and it is yours to drive.
  • Directories, associations and marketplaces: Get Lumiform listed and active where our buyers and partners look, from industry associations to integration marketplaces like SAP and Zapier.
  • Communities and forums: Build a genuine, non-spammy presence in places like Reddit and other communities where our topics get discussed.
  • Entity and profile consistency: Keep Lumiform's name, description and core facts identical across every public profile, so every source and every AI system tells the same story about us.
  • Measurement: Track citations, backlinks, referral traffic and share of voice, and report clearly on what is actually working.

Why You'll Grow Here

  • You own a channel from scratch, not a task list handed down to you
  • You work directly with the founders on their most important marketing bet (be excited about the speed, detail orientation and ownership that comes with it)
  • You become an expert in off-page AEO, a discipline most marketers cannot even name yet. Get good at it now and you are years ahead of the market
  • You get the autonomy to test, ship, and be judged on results rather than hours

Requirements

Who You Are

  • Hungry and hands-on: You get moving without a perfect brief, and you would rather ship and improve than plan forever.
  • AI-native: You have an above-average grasp of LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini), know how to prompt well, and use AI to research, write and scale your outreach.
  • A sharp writer in English (Bonus: German): You can write a pitch, a review reply or an outreach email that people actually answer.
  • A fast learner: You pick up new tools and topics in weeks, not months, and troubleshoot on your own first.
  • Resourceful and organized: You keep many small outreach threads, follow-ups and listings moving in parallel without dropping the ball.

You might have one or two years in marketing, or you might be switching in and can already show you get things done. If you have the hunger but not every line on the list, apply anyway. Bonus points for any experience in PR, SEO, link building, content or community work, familiarity with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, or HubSpot.

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and Nordsee, along with testing, inspection and certification bodies, run millions of inspections through Lumiform every year, making workplaces safer and operations better. We are rated 4.6 on G2, backed by Capnamic and 42CAP, have raised over 10 million euros, and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond.

Why working with us

  • Be part of a company taht has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and fast decision-making.
  • Shape a high-impact role from scratch and work directly with the founders.
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done.

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough, you do not need a cover letter.

Our hiring process

description:

Requirements

What we’re looking for

We don’t believe in checklists - but if most of these apply to you, we’d love to chat:

✔ 5+ years of backend development experience.

✔ 2+ years of experience with a strongly typed language or TypeScript.

✔ Strong experience with RDBMS (raw queries or via ORM).

✔ Solid background in unit and integration testing.

✔ Experience with message brokers (SNS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, etc.).

Bonus: Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, GCP or AWS, gRPC and protobufs.

Bonus: Strong grasp of SOLID principles.

Benefits

Our Values

🚀 Impact Over Effort – We optimize for outcomes, not hours. What matters is the impact we generate for our teams and customers.

💡 Yes, You! – It starts with you. We take ownership, act with initiative, and don’t wait for permission to make things better.

❤️ We Grow Together – As individuals and as a team. We invest in each other and get stronger collectively.

🛠 Ambition At Scale – We think big. We’re building something that matters, and we set the bar high for what’s possible.

We thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. That means adapting quickly, challenging each other constructively, and spending meaningful time together in the office while trusting each other to work flexibly:

  • We love collaborating in the office sharing knowledge with all colleagues, and we do understand the flexibility of working from home when needed

  • We adapt quickly and embrace change in a growth-oriented startup environment

  • We continuously challenge ourselves and each other to improve

This role might not be ideal if:

  • You prefer a highly structured environment.

  • You want a fully remote position.

  • You prefer minimal change and a slower pace.

  • You’re not excited about ownership and growth.

What’s in it for you?

🖥 Apple hardware – The best tools for the job (MacBook).

🏆 Team events – Brunches, sports activities, and quarterly gatherings in Berlin.

🌍 Productivity from Everywhere – 104 days per year remote (post-probation), following our hybrid policy.

🏦 Competitive salary – Tailored to align with your experience level.

🏠 Relocation support – Assistance with paperwork, travel, and one month of furnished accommodation.

What to expect from the hiring process

We respect your time and keep things transparent:

1️⃣ Intro call (~30 min) – Let’s see if we’re a good match.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Review – Your profile is assessed for technical and team fit.

3️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview (~60 min) – Dive into expectations and team dynamics.

4️⃣ Technical Interview (~60–120 min) – Demonstrate your skills.

5️⃣ Meet the Team (Optional) – Connect with your future colleagues.

You’ll always know where you stand - no black holes, no ghosting.

We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, abilities, genders, religions and diverse backgrounds. If you need assistance during the hiring process or in the workplace, let us know!

Don’t meet every requirement? No problem! We’re always open to exceptional candidates and value diversity in all forms.

📩 Apply now – We’d love to connect with you!

description:

  • Fully German-qualified lawyer

  • Business fluent in German and English
  • Strong analytical thinking, confident communication and negotiation skills at C-level and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

CAM Engineer / CAM-Programmierer(m/w/d)
description:
PolyTALENT unterstützt ein stark wachsenden Partner in Hamburg bei der Besetzung dieser verantwortungsvollen Position als CAM Engineer (m/w/d)

Unternehmen

Unser Partner treibt mit fortschrittlichen Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und eigenentwickelter Software die industrielle Beschleunigung kritischer Industrien voran — Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie. Als Teil eines internationalen Fabriknetzwerks entsteht jetzt der erste deutsche Standort in Hamburg.

Benefits

  • Technische Verantwortung über Programmierstandards für das gesamte deutsche Netzwerk

  • Arbeit an sicherheitskritischen Bauteilen für Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Verteidigung

  • Zugang zu modernen 5-Achs-Werkzeugmaschinen und wachsender Automatisierung

  • Equity-Beteiligung an einem skalierenden Fabriknetzwerk

  • Gründungsteam-Rolle — du baust eine Fabrik von Null auf

  • Einfluss auf Werkzeugbibliotheken und Best Practices, die über alle Standorte repliziert werden

  • Leistungskultur mit Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung

Aufgaben

  • CNC-Toolpaths programmieren, simulieren und optimieren (3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Fräsen)

  • Jobs nach Luft- und Raumfahrt- sowie Verteidigungsstandards einrichten, einfahren und produzieren

  • Zykluszeiten reduzieren und Maschinenauslastung von Tag eins verbessern

  • Werkzeuge, Schnittparameter und Spannstrategien für anspruchsvolle Materialien auswählen (z. B. Aluminium, Stähle, Titan, Inconel)

  • Vorrichtungsstrategien entwickeln und verbessern

  • Komplexe technische Zeichnungen und GD&T lesen und interpretieren

  • Toolpath-Bibliotheken, Programmiervorlagen und Dokumentation von Grund auf aufbauen

  • Neuteileeinführungen (NPI) von der Zeichnung bis zur stabilen Produktion unterstützen

  • DFM-Rückmeldungen an Kunden beisteuern

  • Eng mit dem Softwareteam zusammenarbeiten, um Datenerfassung, Planung und Automatisierung zu verbessern

  • Maschinisten auf Programmierstandards schulen, wenn das Team wächst

  • Fabrik mit aufbauen — Maschinen installieren, Anlagen in Betrieb nehmen, Abläufe definieren

    .

Profil

  • Fundierte CAM-Programmiererfahrung (z. B. Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX oder vergleichbar)

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, enge Toleranzen zu fertigen (±0,01 mm und darunter)

  • Erfahrung im Einrichten und Fahren von High-End-CNC-Maschinen (z. B. Hermle, DMG Mori oder vergleichbar)

  • Tiefes Verständnis von Vorschüben, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstrategien und Spanntechnik

  • Hands-on — du kannst sowohl programmieren als auch die Maschine selbst fahren

  • Saubere Dokumentation und Revisionsdisziplin

  • Souverän in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und ohne vorgegebene Strukturen

Wünschenswert

  • Hintergrund in der Luft- und Raumfahrt- oder Verteidigungsfertigung

  • Erfahrung in der simultanen 5-Achs-Bearbeitung

  • Erfahrung mit Titan, Inconel und hochfesten Legierungen

  • NC-Simulationswerkzeuge (z. B. Vericut)

  • Erfahrung mit Messtastern, Automatisierung oder Palettensystemen

  • Kenntnisse in EN 9100 / AS9100

title: Agentic AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on experience in modern AI systems, including agentic AI and generative AI applications. You will support our clients in designing and building intelligent, production-ready systems that leverage LLMs, autonomous agents, and scalable cloud architectures. 

Responsibilities:

·      Design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade systems on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

·      Develop and operate agentic AI systems, including multi-step workflows, tool integration, and autonomous decision-making components.

·      Lead end-to-end implementation of AI-driven features, from prototyping (PoC) to production deployment.

·      Build high-performance APIs and backend services for AI applications using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Spring Boot.

·      Integrate generative AI solutions (LLMs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, orchestration frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph) into enterprise environments.

·      Design and implement robust orchestration and retrieval pipelines for scalable AI applications.

·      Set up and maintain MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and CI/CD workflows for continuous integration, evaluation, and deployment.

·      Ensure software quality through testing, monitoring, observability, and performance optimization.

·      Collaborate closely with clients and cross-functional teams to identify requirements and deliver impactful AI solutions.

 

What we offer you:

·      Work on innovative AI and Software Engineering projects across industries (Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, etc.).

·      Expand your skills in areas such as MLOps, cloud architecture, data engineering, and generative AI.

·      Collaborate with top technology partners in the cloud, AI, and automation ecosystem.

·      Access to training, certifications, and interdisciplinary projects.

·      Join a vibrant community with hackathons, conferences, and knowledge-sharing events.

·      Award-winning office space in downtown Munich with great transport connections.

·      Flexible working model between client site, Reply office, and remote work.

Deutschlandticket for public


Job requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

·      Completed university studies with a strong quantitative or technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar).

·      Ideally, you have already gained some initial consulting and project management experience Teamwork & Collaboration – ability to work effectively with others toward common objectives.

·      Adaptability – flexibility in taking on different roles within a team and understand the need of the costumer

·      Solid programming experience in at least two programming languages such as Python, Java, Rust, or JavaScript.

·      Practical experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments (on-premises or cloud).

·      Experience with different database technologies, including SQL and NoSQL, with knowledge of database design, data modeling, and data management.

·      Experience with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating generative AI into actual solutions.

·      Strong communication skills for explaining technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

·      Fluent in English and at least C1-level German. This requirement is mandatory.

 

 

Desired Qualifications:

·      Hands-on experience with cloud AI services.

·      Understanding of MLOps concepts (model registry, monitoring, CI/CD).

·      Knowledge of modern AI/ML frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, or OpenAI APIs.

·      Awareness of software engineering principles (SOLID, testing, version control).

·      Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

·      Cloud certifications are a plus.

·      Teamwork & Collaboration – ability to work effectively with others toward common objectives.

·      Adaptability – flexibility in taking on different roles within a team and understand the need of the costumer

 

What are you waiting for?

Join our team at Machine Learning Reply as a Consultant for Software Engineering and AI in Munich or Berlin!

title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
Software Engineer (Future Hiring)
description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership

  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams

  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance 
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring
